spec.scope: enemy-target debuff that ALSO opens a named status window ('Calling Card') gating S1-3 and S2-1; not a self stat
spec.durationSemantics: 5 sec wall-clock status window; refreshed ONLY by hits on a non-CC target — cannot self-refresh while active (its own trigger excludes CC targets), so the window genuinely lapses
spec.triggerIdentity: normal-attack landing on a target NOT in Calling Card state — a status-absence-gated on-hit application; nearest trap is an ungated every-hit application
spec.targetSet: the enemy (boss-held debuff: buffApply with casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null, filtered by stat+value)
spec.nearestWrongModel: applying/refreshing Calling Card on EVERY normal hit (ignoring the 'not in the Calling Card state' clause) — this locks the fight into permanent CC, kills the Thief's Dagger stack cycle, and turns S1-3 into an always-on buff; or encoding it as a self defPct (inert) with NO targetStatus channel, silently breaking both downstream gates
spec.distinguishingAssertion: first shot on the boss emits the boss-debuff buffApply and opens the CC window; during the open window NO new CC application/refresh appears (it can only re-apply after lapse); after the 5s lapse the next shot re-applies it. RED under ungated-refresh (CC buffApply on every shot, never lapses) and RED under status-less encoding (S1-3 buffs fire pre-CC)
spec.inertness: must grant Phantom ZERO self stats; must not appear as a friendly buffApply; must not extend while the window is open

spec.kitLine: Thief's Dagger: Hit Rate ▲ 25.75%. Stacks up to 3…5 sec.
spec.scope: self Hit Rate (core-hit lift path, hitRatePct) — NOT crit rate, NOT attack damage
spec.durationSemantics: 5 sec per application, maxStacks 3; accrual is rate-limited by the CC window (≈1 stack per 5s CC cycle, since the granting trigger excludes CC targets) — NOT 1 stack per shot
spec.triggerIdentity: same status-absence-gated normal-attack trigger as S1-1; stack is consumed by the S2 max-stacks event
spec.nearestWrongModel: stacking on every normal attack (3 stacks in 3 shots → S2 nuke every 3rd shot instead of every ~2 CC windows), or encoding Hit Rate as critRatePct/critRateNormalPct
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'hitRatePct' value 25.75 with stacks climbing 1→3, maxStacks 3, durationSec 5 — and successive stack buffApplies are spaced at least one CC-window apart (never stacks 1,2,3 within the first three shots of the fight); zero critRatePct/critRateNormalPct buffApply sourced from skill1
spec.inertness: no atkPct / attackDamagePct / critRatePct from this line; no ally copies

spec.scope: self generic Damage-Up (attackDamagePct), all of Phantom's damage for its short window
spec.durationSemantics: ROUND count — durationShots:1 (expires after the holder fires 1 round, Nth shot still benefits), NEVER durationSec; no time expiry at all in the usual encoding
spec.triggerIdentity: normal-attack landing on a target IN Calling Card state — requiresTargetStatus 'Calling Card' gate on the on-hit trigger
spec.nearestWrongModel: durationSec:1 (wall-clock) — collapses the window across fire-rate/reload timing and contradicts the round semantics; or an UNGATED always-refreshing attackDamagePct that also fires before CC is ever applied
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'attackDamagePct' value 75.17 carries durationShots===1 (not a 1s expiresFrame) and appears ONLY while a CC window is open — zero such buffApply before the first CC application, and its apply-count ≈ shots landed inside CC windows. RED under durationSec encoding (expiry decoupled from shots fired) and RED under ungated encoding (buffApply on shot #1)

spec.kitLine: Deals 84.33% of final ATK as additional damage. Removes Calling Card.
spec.scope: instant flatDamage rider at 84.33% of final ATK on CC-carrying targets; flavor is plain 'additional damage' — NOT distributed, so distributedDamagePct buffs must NOT feed it
spec.durationSemantics: instant single hit per trigger; no duration component
spec.triggerIdentity: Thief's Dagger reaching max stacks (3) — a stack-threshold event that CONSUMES the stacks (reset to 0) and removes Calling Card, restarting the S1 cycle
spec.targetSet: enemies in Calling Card status (the boss in the fixture)
spec.nearestWrongModel: re-firing on every hit while at max stacks (stacks never consumed → a nuke every shot); tagging flavor 'distributed' so the S2 DD buffs amplify it; or never removing Calling Card so S1-3 stays live and the stack loop never resets
spec.distinguishingAssertion: exactly ONE damage event with mult 0.8433 per 3-stack cycle (event count over the fight == number of stack cycles, far below shot count); immediately after it, dagger stacks read 0 (next non-CC hit shows stacks:1 again) and the CC debuff is gone (S1-1 re-application follows); the event's magnitude is IDENTICAL across DD-stack states. RED under no-consume (0.8433 events ≈ shots) and RED under distributed flavor (event grows with DD stacks)
spec.inertness: must not be boosted by distributedDamagePct; must not leave CC or stacks in place after firing

spec.kitLine: Distributed Damage ▲ 12.86% continuously. …removed after Burst Skill is used.
spec.scope: self distributedDamagePct — feeds only distributed-flavored hits (the burst nuke), not the 84.33% additional-damage rider, not normal attacks
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' = NO durationSec (permanent stacking, maxStacks 3); stacks cleared by Phantom's OWN burst use — and removed AFTER the burst resolves, so the casting burst itself benefits from the pre-removal stacks

spec.nearestWrongModel: giving it a wall-clock durationSec (falls off between cycles); never removing on burst (post-burst bursts keep full stacks); or removing BEFORE/at cast so the burst hit loses the stacks it should enjoy
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'distributedDamagePct' value 12.86 accrues stacks 1→2→3 across successive cycles with no expiresFrame; Phantom's burst cast at 3 stacks lands WITH the 38.58pp DD included, and her NEXT burst (post-reset, before rebuilding) is lower by ≈ that delta. RED under never-removed (burst #2 ≥ burst #1 given equal other state) and RED under pre-removal (burst #1 lacks the stack contribution)
spec.inertness: no ally copies; must not amplify the 84.33% rider or normal attacks; must not persist through her own burst

spec.kitLine: ATK ▲ 85.12% for 5 sec. / Distributed Damage ▲ 31.92% for 10 sec.

spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:10 — 'after landing 10 normal attacks' counts ROUNDS (hits), recurring every 10 cumulative hits; not an interval, not a passive, not burst-gated
spec.nearestWrongModel: passive from t=0 (over-credits the opening seconds), interval:10s (decouples from actual fire cadence/reloads), or team-wide targeting

spec.kitLine: Deals 1457.28% of final ATK as Distributed Damage.
spec.scope: burst-cast instant nuke, flavor 'distributed' — MUST be fed by Phantom's own distributedDamagePct buffs (S2-2 stacks + S2-3 31.92%); crit at her sheet rate, NO core bucket (kit does not say core)

skill1: Calling Card: DEF ▼ 32.19% for 5 sec. (DEF-shred MAGNITUDE only — the 'Calling Card' status window itself must still be modeled as a targetStatus for the S1-3/S2-1 gates)

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in order of blast radius: (1) 'for 1 round(s)' encoded as durationSec:1 instead of durationShots:1 — the single most likely trap on this kit. (2) Ungated Thief's Dagger accrual: the kit's own 'not in the Calling Card state' clause rate-limits stacks to ~1 per 5s CC window; an every-hit model makes the S2 nuke fire every 3 shots instead of ~every 10-15s — a multi-x damage divergence that calibration can hide. Whole-picture trajectory to sanity-check: hit on non-CC target → CC applied (5s) + dagger stack 1; hits during the window each grant the 1-round Attack Damage buff; after lapse, next hit → stack 2 + CC refresh; stack 3 at ~10s+ immediately fires S2 (84.33% nuke, +12.86% DD stack, CC removed, daggers reset); repeat, DD capping at 3 stacks (38.58%) until her own burst clears them AFTER the burst lands. (3) Tagging the 84.33% 'additional damage' as distributed — the kit reserves 'Distributed Damage' wording for the S2 buffs and the burst; the rider must not eat DD buffs. (4) burstCast vs fullBurstEnter on the burst nuke — invisible in a comp where she bursts every rotation, so the assertion must pin the event to her own burstCast. (5) Hit Rate mis-keyed as crit — hitRatePct→core magnitude is measured-only ⚑ (ALWAYS-⚑ #7); an honest flag with estimate+recipe is correct, a precise invented value is wrong. (6) The DEF ▼ 32.19% magnitude has no enemy-DEF channel in the schema (defPct is self-only/inert): either it sits verbatim in unmodeled or it is proxied via damageTakenPct — the proxy is a ⚑ approximation and must be labeled as such; what is NON-negotiable is the named status window, since two other lines gate on it. (7) 'Stacks are removed after Burst Skill is used' has no first-class removeOnBurst primitive — if the encoding approximates it, that is a GAP to flag, not to hide. (8) Cadence tuple (fire rate / reloadFrames 141) is datamine-unreliable ⚑ per the standing rule.
